artworks.label: Pistachio eclair
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for pistachio-parlour. One exquisite miniature pistachio eclair on a small scalloped ivory patisserie plate, golden crisp choux shell filled with a generous pale-pistachio cream swirl, smooth muted-green glaze, finely chopped pistachios and one delicate cream pastry blossom. Premium realistic patisserie still-life photography, tactile baked crumb and silky cream, warm cream/pistachio/biscuit-brown palette, soft natural light. No macaron, croissant, ice-cream sundae, mouse or whisk. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
